title: Keep TypeScript safety checks enabled
why: Explicitly disabling strict typing, implicit-any checks, or strict null checks removes compiler guarantees and lets avoidable runtime failures reach review.
suggestion: Enable the compiler option and resolve the resulting type errors, or document a narrowly scoped override instead of weakening the project configuration.
limitations: Only explicit false values for strict, noImplicitAny, and strictNullChecks inside compilerOptions are reported.
Inherited settings, project references, and equivalent command-line overrides are not resolved.
